version.changelog: Add mailbuttons.com intro + sign-up/docs links for discoverability.

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed sandbox email-integration helper, with some dependency and over-triggering cautions but no artifact-backed malicious behavior.

dimensions.detail: Repo inspection, writing a policy file, scaffolding code, and running sandbox email self-tests are proportionate to the stated purpose and are described to the user.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill package contains only Markdown instructions and references, with no executable bundled files; however, the Claude Agent SDK reference uses unpinned npx execution of @mailbuttons/mcp-server while passing a sandbox token.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The activation text is broad for generic agent email requests, but the requested behavior remains tied to agent email setup and the workflow requires policy review, user confirmation, and human approval for production or external sending.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill uses a sandbox API key from the environment and a one-time account API key for provisioning, but it repeatedly states not to hard-code secrets, not to approve its own promotion, and not to widen token scope.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifacts consistently describe setting up a governed Mailbuttons inbox for agents, including sandbox provisioning, policy generation, scaffolded integration code, governed send/read tools, self-test, and human-only promotion.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, verify that MAILBUTTONS_API_KEY is truly sandbox-scoped, keep account API keys out of code, review the generated policy before continuing, and pin the MCP server package instead of running an unpinned latest version with npx.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad trigger examples could cause invocation for generic agent-email requests, but they remain purpose-aligned and do not by themselves create hidden access or automatic escalation.
[T08] expected: Running a Mailbuttons MCP server with a sandbox token is expected for the Claude SDK integration, but using unpinned npx is a real supply-chain caution users should mitigate by pinning and reviewing the package.
